text:
jamie_sre: :rotating_light: noticing large spike in POST /v1/embeddings from a cluster of IPs from APAC city ranges. Spike started ~ 1759999900, sustained high RPS. Many requests look identical, short inputs.
incident-bot: Incident created: ID INC-2026-042. Paging oncall. Severity: high. Linked runbook: /runbooks/embeddings-abuse.md
marco_oncall: oncall here, looking. do we have customer-facing impact yet?
jamie_sre: some customers (3 orgs) seeing 429s and increased tail latency on embeddings; overall token success rate dropped ~12%. Traffic pattern: many small payloads, high fanout. sample curl from logs: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer anon:'`
cora_cx: flagged by support — two paying customers reported timeouts, one asked to pause traffic. We should prep a short CX blurb.
anya_prod: agree, will draft. For mitigation: propose immediate geo-slice for APAC embedding requests + reduce anonymous token batch size. Also enable short-lived quota cut for anything >100 rps per token.
marco_oncall: sounds good. can we do a rapid rule push? nate_edge can you apply a temporary geofence rate-slice and push a WAF rule to tarpit obvious scraper UA?
nate_edge: applying WAF rule now to block/ratelimit suspect ASN ranges and add `x-tarpit: 1` header for slow responders. pushing geofence to edge config: `edgectl apply -f geofence-apac-embeddings.yaml` -> initiated. ETA ~45s.
jamie_sre: also flipping embeddings-batch endpoint to require authenticated key for now (disable anonymous batching): `feature-toggle set embeddings.batch.anonymous false --env prod`
incident-bot: Action logged: WAF rule 94321 applied by nate_edge. Feature toggle change requested by jamie_sre.
marco_oncall: executing quota cut play: reduce per-token concurrency to 20 for anonymous keys, will monitor error counts.
cora_cx: drafting CX note: short summary + mitigation + ask customers to escalate if they continue to see 5xx/429. will share draft in ~10m.
anya_prod: recommend also enabling caching for repeated inputs (prefix dedupe) — low effort, high payoff. can someone open a quick job to backfill cache rules?
jamie_sre: i'll spin up a short job to fingerprint repeated inputs + apply KV cache rule at edge layer. command: `python tools/fingerprint_cache.py --window 60 --threshold 5`
nate_edge: WAF + geofence in place. seeing immediate drop in suspicious RPS from target ranges (~75% down). native traffic looks stable so far.
marco_oncall: good. leaving oncall to monitor for next 30m. jamie, can you capture a short postmortem stub with timeline and mitigations so CX + SRE can flesh out?
jamie_sre: will do — I'll record timestamps, IPs, ASN, the exact rules we pushed, and estimated customer impact.
incident-bot: Incident severity lowered to medium based on telemetry. Next update at 1760000600 or when status changes. :white_check_mark:
marco_oncall: thx team. :thumbsup:
